name: ble_remote
title: BLE Remote
description: LVGL touch keyboard, mousepad, gamepad and persistent BLE host manager for compatible PAX firmware.
author: PAX workspace
license: Apache-2.0 (app); LVGL MIT; BLE backend GPL-3.0
about: Requires BLE-peripheral enabled PAX firmware with the optional BLE Remote service. Includes no Bluetooth stack; the firmware owns pairing and BLE HID. The app releases controls on close.
controls: Keyboard: US keys; ABC uppercase, 1# symbols
Ctrl, Alt, Win latch; Esc and Tab are below the keyboard
Mousepad: move, click, drag and scroll
Hosts: select, connect, disconnect, pair, rename or forget
Close or L3: release controls and return to launcher
changelog: 0.4.0: replaced the custom key grid with LVGL’s keyboard widget and retained HID key, modifier, mouse, gamepad, and host controls.
